newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares end down but off lows in edgy market.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares end down but off lows in edgy market.

text.p: Italian stocks lost early gains and closed above session lows on Tuesday after a nervous session with the market continuing its recent correction, depressed by the dollar's strength and a poor performance in Italian Btps.
Traded volume was seen slightly up on Monday at around 1.3 trillion lire. Energy group ENI's recovery in the afternoon helped support other stocks.
News that Italy mutual funds July inflow was seen double that of June was largely discounted. The market is awaiting details of the equity fund breakdown when official data is published on Wednesday.
The All-share Mibtel index closed off 0.79 percent at 14,324 after a session low at 14,247. The Mib30 blue chip index ended down 0.96 percent at 21,654 after a 21,533 low.
Bellwether stock ENI gained 0.65 percent to 10,352 lire after opening at 10,320 and a session low at 10,205, but private energy producer Edison lost 2.12 percent to 8,020.
Fiat pared some losses towards the close to end 0.29 percent off at 5,896 lire.
Pirelli SpA gained 1.08 percent to 4,785 after winning an Indonesian contract and Olivetti put on 2.71 percent to 645.
Telecoms were easier, with mobile phone operator TIM off 1.01 percent to 6,065.
Banks were mixed, with Credito Italiano down 2.86 percent to 3,325 but Ambroveneto gained 1.39 percent to 9,597.
